actions: Pinned current DriftLens main and inspected the experiments README, UC8 tree, training/embedding-extraction tree, standard UC8 wrapper and UC8 scoring entrypoint.
Confirmed the current GitHub UC8 tree lacks tracked static HDF5/output artifacts while the wrapper references radius-2 HDF5s and the README says extracted embeddings will be provided soon.
Confirmed the standard UC8 wrapper does not pass --run_driftlens, while the entrypoint makes the DriftLens branch opt-in and writes DriftLens accuracy -1 when skipped.
Pinned the public historical commit that introduced the --run_driftlens gate and observed that it modified the standard blur wrapper without adding the flag.
Confirmed the current GitHub releases endpoint is empty and repository filename searches surface UC8 radius2 embeddings/results as references/generators rather than tracked generated artifacts.

Verified that the final paper declares separate supplementary downloadable material, while the supplement payload itself could not be inspected through the available public routes; preserved that uncertainty rather than treating the supplement as absent.
Published and read back a source-qualified replay-readiness audit.

assessment.material_result: The current public GitHub surface is insufficient for exact UC8 final-table replay: required radius-2 embeddings/result receipts are not tracked and the standard wrapper currently omits the flag needed to execute DriftLens. This is a reproducibility/provenance gap, not a contradiction of the paper's result, because the final paper separately declares supplementary material that was not inspectable in this pass and private/table-producing commands may differ.

termination.cause: bounded checkpoint after fourth high-value C11 audit; recurring frontier remains nonempty

exact_next_action: Inspect the declared IEEE supplementary payload or an archival mirror for the missing UC8 replay bundle; if absent there too, retain exact replay as artifact-blocked and keep any reconstruction explicitly separate from reproduction of the published table.
